description: manni docs cite/set-up/citations-in-a-sidecar, run in the page's example repository: manni.config.yaml with the site and guides collections, docs-citations.yaml, guides-citations.yaml, docs/, guides/guide.md and lib/.

steps.description: Read alone, the page's own bytes carry no citations.
With the config governing the run, the merged view carries the manifest's entry.
Check exactly as before: a fourth column names the manifest and the entry's first line.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:6 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current\s+docs-citations\.yaml:5[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: A finding about the entry itself sits on the manifest, on the entry's own first line.

runShell.stdio: /bad-pin\s+\/source\/integrity must match pattern[\s\S]*\(docs-citations\.yaml:42\)[\s\S]*1 file checked, 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 finding/

steps.description: -f github annotates the manifest at that line.
A half-moved page has two owners for one key: an error naming the manifest and the collection.

runShell.stdio: "citations" is owned by manifest docs-citations.yaml (collection site); remove it from the document

steps.description: meta validate reports the same page as external:owned.
add needs no flag: the entry goes to the manifest, and the claim stays on the line that was typed.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/retries.md:6 lib/limits.ts:3 --id retries --dry-run
runShell.stdio: /docs\/retries\.md: added retries to docs-citations\.yaml:59 \(claim at line 6, sha256-d33051d7…; source lib\/limits\.ts:3/

steps.description: update repairs two entries in one manifest and writes it once.

runShell.stdio: /docs\/moved\.md: fetch-timeout source lib\/moved\.ts:2 -> lib\/moved\.ts:4 \(moved\)[\s\S]*2 citations rewritten in 2 files, 0 skipped/

steps.description: A manifest keyed by slug: the page carrying slug: guide-one owns the entry.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:7 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current\s+guides-citations\.yaml:4[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: Write a config whose site manifest is a URL.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('url.config.yaml','collections:
  - name: site
    paths: [docs/**/*.md]
    externalMetadata:
      - file: https://example.com/citations.yaml
        keys: [citations]
')"

steps.description: Refusal one: a URL manifest cannot own citations, exit 2.

runShell.stdio: collection site: citations cannot come from a URL manifest, because cite writes them.

steps.description: Write a config where two collections, each with a manifest owning citations, match one page.

runShell.command:
node -e "const f=require('fs');f.writeFileSync('api-citations.yaml','{}
');f.writeFileSync('conflict.config.yaml','collections:
  - name: site
    paths: [docs/**/*.md]
    externalMetadata:
      - file: ./docs-citations.yaml
        keys: [citations]
  - name: api
    paths: [docs/limits.md]
    externalMetadata:
      - file: ./api-citations.yaml
        keys: [citations]
')"

steps.description: Refusal two: a page in two collections that both keep citations in a manifest, exit 2.

runShell.stdio: docs/limits.md is in collections site and api, and both keep citations in a manifest.

steps.description: Refusal three: add reading the page from stdin has no path to key the manifest entry by, exit 2.

runShell.command:
node -e "process.stdout.write('---
title: T
---
# T

The fetch timeout is 10 seconds.
')" | manni cite add -:6 lib/limits.ts:2 --as markdown --id t
runShell.stdio: A page read from stdin has no path, and its citations live in docs-citations.yaml, which is keyed by path.
